subject: not for the faint hearted...
author: drunknnumpty
body:
hey sonic, like the idea.. however, 5 rounds of 6 laps?? seems a little over kill for a tournament.. i could understand 5 rounds 3 laps, or 3 rounds 6 laps.. however am I alone in thinking that you'ed have to spend a lot of time in a room with only one other player.. i could also understand a six round full room tourny with each person pickig a track of their preference.. this way you would get the banter and talking that is part and parcel of burnin.. it would also make the racing a lot more fun if there are more targets.. err. opposition than just racing one on one.. just think of it this way.. would it be fun racing six lappers with no competition due to the other person not having the skill or ability to keep up.. or even worse the other way round.. getting one of the top guys and getting absolutely thrashed for 5 rounds (I don't particularly like the word TIMEOUT).. just think you should come up with a few formats for the tourny.. or even get Xan to have it as a question on the poll at get all the aholics to vote which format should be adopted..

feel free to disagree, ignore, abuse and insult me.. happy to take it.. but from experience you want a format that people want to come back to again and again and having more competition in the room is certainly something that I find more enjoyable than a half full room..

also don't think my attention span is up to half an hour racing in one sitting.. when would I get to take my time out to smoke my joint.. ;)

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
